title: Explicit design-system omissions
summary: Mark undefined token groups intentionally, with a reason, so agents do not invent a brand palette, radius scale or component language that was never specified.
when_to_use: A design system is partial or a new project has only a few confirmed visual rules.
avoid_when: The omitted choice is necessary to satisfy an immediate accessibility or functional requirement; ask or use a clearly labeled temporary default.

anatomy.purpose: Lists absent groups and explains why each is absent.
Identifies any local implementation default that is not a brand rule.

responsive: Do not infer mobile spacing or typography from desktop-only evidence; record that uncertainty explicitly.
accessibility: A missing color group cannot justify inaccessible contrast; use an explicit temporary accessible fallback.
implementation_steps: Separate confirmed tokens from missing groups.
Document why each group is omitted and what the agent may decide locally.
Request a product decision before promoting a fallback into the shared design system.
